results.name: A1 a host call during a sleep ends it and one slice runs at once; the stale timer does nothing
A1b a status read during a sleep also ends it (every controller function is wrapped)
A2 timer end resumes into exactly one tick; short waits are not slept on
A5 pause during a sleep: no slice while paused; resume schedules exactly one tick
A5b rapid pause->resume while asleep leaves one tick, not two
A5c stop during a sleep: done resolves 'stopped', no slice afterwards, a late timer or tick is inert
A8/A9 without the policy: the wait is never taken, nothing sleeps, the controller is not wrapped
TICKET a delivery during a tick's await voids the wait that tick took (needs an await: not reachable on an admitted boot)
A2 random interleavings (300 seeds x 120 steps): never two pending ticks, never a stall, never a slice while paused/stopped
